purpose: Resolves this repository's grade10/grade11/grade12 tree contract against Cambridge International's own stages. Read this before trusting any grade number in the CAMBRIDGE tree.
problem: Cambridge is a global curriculum author using its own stages (Cambridge Primary, Cambridge Lower Secondary, Cambridge Upper Secondary = IGCSE/O Level, Cambridge Advanced = AS & A Level), not national grade numbers. This repository's tree contract is grade10/grade11/grade12, the South African FET phase used by the CAPS and IEB trees.
convention_status: REPOSITORY CONVENTION, not a Cambridge statement. Every syllabus file repeats this caveat.

grade11.note: IGCSE examination normally sat at the end of this year.

alternative_pathways.description: IGCSE taught across Grades 9-10, AS in Grade 11, A Level (A2) in Grade 12. Common where a school starts Cambridge earlier.
IGCSE completed in one year, which Cambridge states happens in some countries. Collapses the grade10/grade11 span of the default pathway.
alternative_pathways.note: Recorded because Cambridge documents it, not because it is common in the South African schools this repo currently serves.

unresolved: A full Cambridge International A Level is a two-year course of which AS is year one, so a school on the default pathway completes A2 in a thirteenth year, which has no grade12-keyed slot in this contract. A Level must NOT be silently folded into grade12. Any product serving Cambridge A Level students has to decide how to represent that year; this tree does not invent one.

stages.name: Cambridge Advanced
stages.typical_course_length_years: AS 1 year; full A Level 2 years
